title: Safar jahaan se moulae kayenaat ka hai
body:
safar jahaan se moula e kayenaat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkilaat ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
lahu me doop ke ham to huwe hain sarafraaz
hassan tamaam karao namaziyou'n ki namaz
khayaal kitna imaamat ko wajibaat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkilaat ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan hussain tadapte hai'n baap ke gham me
shareek hazrat-e-abbas bhi hain matam me
malaal sub ko yateemi ke hadesaat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkilaat ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qayamat ek bapa ho rahi hai masjid me ke janemaaze ali ro rahi hai masjid me
sahar tadapti hai chehra nidhaal raat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkilaat kahai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisa haaye sitamgar ne zulm dhaya hai
usi ka masjid e kufa me khoo'n bahaya hai
qadam qadam pa muhafiz jo deeniyaat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi kiaal pa ye waqt mushkilaat ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nikal raha hai nabi ke wazeer ka taboot ke uthraha hai janabe ameer ka taboot
ali ke sog me kufa tasawwuraat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkilaat ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
falak hilaati hai zainab ke shor o shain ki dhoom
tadap rahi hai janaze pa baap ke kulsoom
gila naseeb se be aasrahaya at ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkila at ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke dete hain moula pisar ke haath me haath
na chordna kabhi abbas tum hussain ka saath
ye meralaal asasaa nabi ki zaat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkilaat ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
payambarou ke labao par hai siskiya'n akhtar
na barse kaise jahaa'n me udasiya'n akhtar
ye dee'n muhafize islam ki wafaat ka hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki aal pa ye waqt mushkilaat ka hai
